layout formula: One focal person centered slightly off-axis, 2-3 supporting props, light background context, open lower corners.
composition zones: Top: seasonal cues; Center: face/body focal point; Mid-lower: hands/object; Edges: light framing motifs.
recommended use: Healing, rest, journaling, breathwork, tea, window scenes.
seasonal swap: Swap clothing, window/weather, plants, props by season.
notes: Best for emotionally intimate pages and cover-adjacent interiors.

layout formula: 3-5 people in curved or circular arrangement, one clear focal interaction, simple room geometry.
composition zones: Top: wall/window/banners minimal; Center: group interaction; Bottom: chairs, floor, grounding objects.
recommended use: Meetings, support groups, peer conversations, family encouragement.
white space rule: Keep background under 30% detail so figures stay readable.
seasonal swap: Change décor, window scene, clothing layers, table props.
notes: No crowd scenes; emotional clarity matters more than realism.

layout formula: Short centered quote with wide margins and seasonal border motifs on 2-4 sides.
composition zones: Top-third: quote; Outer frame: florals/symbols; Corners: accent clusters; Center whitespace preserved.
recommended use: Affirmations, bilingual phrases, short recovery lines.
white space rule: Preserve at least 50% open space around text.
seasonal swap: Rotate border motif families by season and line identity.
notes: Keep phrase short enough to color around comfortably.

layout formula: One room with strong furniture silhouette, layered comfort objects, single anchor light source or window.
composition zones: Top: wall art/window; Center: bed/chair/table anchor; Lower: rug, books, slippers, plants.
recommended use: Bedrooms, reading nooks, living rooms, meditation corners.
white space rule: Avoid filling every surface with pattern; leave floors and walls partially open.
quote placement: Optional art print on wall only.
seasonal swap: Swap textiles, weather view, drinkware, lighting mood.
notes: Good for quiet pacing between social pages.

layout formula: 8-15 related motifs grouped in balanced clusters with breathing room between forms.
composition zones: Distributed clusters across full page with one central anchor motif.
recommended use: Flowers, candles, hearts, books, mugs, butterflies, stars, leaves.
white space rule: Keep clean separations between motifs for easy coloring.
seasonal swap: Motifs shift by season while retaining brand symbols.
notes: Use as pacing reset pages and bonus printable pages.

layout formula: Single figure in motion on path/sidewalk with calm background depth and limited environmental clutter.
composition zones: Top: sky/trees/buildings minimal; Center: walking figure; Lower: path, leaves, flowers, pavement texture.
recommended use: Morning walks, recovery reflection, outdoor grounding.
white space rule: Keep large sky/path zones open to avoid density.
seasonal swap: Change foliage, weather, clothing, light direction.
notes: Great recurring template across all three lines.

layout formula: 2-3 seated figures with tea or journals, porch railing or patio edge, relaxed conversation posture.
composition zones: Top: plants/string lights/window; Center: seated figures; Bottom: floorboards/rug/table.
recommended use: Friend support, elder guidance, family reconnection.
white space rule: Keep railing, walls, and floor simple enough for color fill.
seasonal swap: Swap plants, blankets, lanterns, drink types, clothing layers.
notes: Useful for warm relational scenes without crowding.

layout formula: Person seated near window holding journal or tea, outside view simplified, indoor comfort props nearby.
composition zones: Top: window frame and weather; Center: seated figure; Lower: blanket, book, mug, plant.
white space rule: Window scene should stay simple and not compete with figure.
seasonal swap: Rain, flowers, sunlight, falling leaves, snow, candles.
notes: A foundational template for all seasonal books.
